items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: As I mentioned, Don Byas used to come over and play with us in Hot Lips Page band.

ctx.x: Anyways, you were talking about Lucky Thompson.

Lucky what has to be one of the greatest musicians that I have ever had the good fortune to work with him to know. He is a great human being and a fantastic saxophone player. His idol was Don Byas. But, I think Don Byas-- I think he would've been Don's idol. If Don had known him and heard him play best – he had such a wonderful technique, his ideas, his flow of ideas, his style technique, his facility, his feeling, his sensitivity anything you want to name… Any attribute that would be important to a performer,…
Was that evident to you then? Or is that evident to you now?
